title: WOLF / Continuous Motor Study
authorship: Original Mechanism Studio composition, deterministic synthesis and editorial motion effects. No third-party samples, voice services or recordings.
musicalFeel: Quiet opening, continuous reveal phrases, a lighter single-magnet close-up, then a soft rising reassembly and resolved loop. No drums, narration or label dings.
timing: One seekable PCM clock: seconds = beat * 60 / 112. Cues derive from the actual v2 motion-event windows and retained source occurrence IDs.

mix.effects: Smooth filtered-air motion textures and three soft hardware seating cues. Editorial accents, not simulated friction, contact or physical motor sound.

automation.method: Continuous smoothstep gain, with matching beginning and ending gain.

effects.clock: Baked into the same PCM buffer. No wall-clock timers or scene restarts.
effects.repetitionPolicy: One continuous wave per repeated source family and movement phase; never one impact per magnet or cc occurrence.

events.gainReference: Synthesized event mono sample peak before equal-power center panning.
